violation_type.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Sitting) (26 TAC §746.4813(a))
violation_type.short_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Sitting)
violation_type.typical_finding: The use zone of a rotating device was deficient as observed during inspection. Another play equipment and a table were less than 6 feet away from the rotating device.    NOTE: This was corrected during inspection. The table and play equipment was moved to comply with use zone.

finding_variants.text: The use zone of a rotating device was deficient as observed during inspection. Another play equipment and a table were less than 6 feet away from the rotating device.    NOTE: This was corrected during inspection. The table and play equipment was moved to comply with use zone.

There are  pieces of equipment on the playground that do not have 6 feet use zones, and there use zones overlap.   There is a piece of equipment that needs surfacing added along with the correct use zone.

A see saw on springs did not have a use zone of six feet around due to black playground barriers impeding on the use zone.   Noted: This was corrected during inspection when the barriers were moved to allow the six feet around the equipment.
The multi child  tricycle ride located on the playground does not have the required 6 feet of use zone between it and the concrete sidewalk.
There was a rotating equipment that lacked the use zone perimeter. A rocking equipment lacked the use zone perimeter. It overlapped the use zoe of other equipment.
Marry-go-cycle in outside playground had a use zone of approximately 3 feet.
